briarback-boar.name: Briarback boar
briarback-boar.appearance: A heavy boar with coarse dark bristles and thorny growths along its shoulders.
briarback-boar.signs: Cloven prints, churned soil and bark scraped at shoulder height.
briarback-boar.behaviour: Charges when surprised or when its young are approached. Give it a clear route away.
briarback-boar.advice: Put a tree between you and its tusks, then drive it away.
briarback-boar.materialsNote: Recover usable binding thread from the overturned supply cart. A separate rare component is used for advanced equipment or permanent castle improvements.

slatehide-lizard.name: Slatehide lizard
slatehide-lizard.appearance: A low, broad reptile with overlapping grey plates and an olive belly.
slatehide-lizard.signs: A tail furrow between four-footed tracks; warm stones polished by resting bodies.
slatehide-lizard.behaviour: Basks near a sheltered nest and faces intruders with its plated back.
slatehide-lizard.advice: Lure it away from its nest before crossing the exposed ledge.
slatehide-lizard.materialsNote: Mineral-rich clay is scraped from the lizard’s abandoned ledge. A separate rare component is used for advanced equipment or permanent castle improvements.

storm-antler-stag.name: Storm-antler stag
storm-antler-stag.appearance: A tawny deer whose dark branching antlers hold a small electrical charge.
storm-antler-stag.signs: Split hoofprints and scorched tips on low branches after storms.
storm-antler-stag.behaviour: Usually flees. A cornered stag lowers its antlers and discharges at close range.
storm-antler-stag.advice: Keep your distance and guide it toward open ground.
storm-antler-stag.materialsNote: Recover a moon-glass fragment exposed where the stag’s charge struck the old boundary stones. A separate rare component is used for advanced equipment or permanent castle improvements.

giant-marsh-crab.name: Giant marsh crab
giant-marsh-crab.appearance: A mud-brown crab with reeds caught in its shell joints and one enlarged claw.
giant-marsh-crab.signs: Broad drag marks, broken reeds and shell fragments along muddy banks.
giant-marsh-crab.behaviour: Defends a feeding place and seizes anything pushed within reach.
giant-marsh-crab.advice: Place bait away from the crossing to draw it off.
giant-marsh-crab.materialsNote: Clean porous clay is gathered from the bank after the crossing is safe. A separate rare component is used for advanced equipment or permanent castle improvements.

lantern-moth.name: Lantern moth
lantern-moth.appearance: A large moth with parchment-coloured wings and softly lit amber markings.
lantern-moth.signs: Wing dust on lamp glass and matching bite marks on soft leaves.
lantern-moth.behaviour: Follows strong lights. Disturbed moths beat dust into the air and obscure movement.
lantern-moth.advice: Shade the party’s lamps and set a small decoy light off the path.
lantern-moth.materialsNote: Warm resin left beneath the feeding tree can be cleaned into sun amber. A separate rare component is used for advanced equipment or permanent castle improvements.

grave-silk-spider.name: Grave-silk spider
grave-silk-spider.appearance: A pale living spider with long legs and dense white silk. It is not undead.
grave-silk-spider.signs: Low trip threads, wrapped beetles and thick silk around sheltered corners.
grave-silk-spider.behaviour: Waits behind web anchors, then rushes whatever disturbs a trip line.
grave-silk-spider.advice: Trace its silk anchors and clear a route around the web.
grave-silk-spider.materialsNote: Ordinary abandoned silk is cleaned and spun into binding thread; the rare intact strands are kept separately. A separate rare component is used for advanced equipment or permanent castle improvements.

reed-lurker.name: Reed lurker
reed-lurker.appearance: A long olive amphibian with four strong legs and reed-like growths above its eyes.
reed-lurker.signs: A sliding belly track into water and reeds bent toward a concealed resting hollow.
reed-lurker.behaviour: Waits in shallow water, then lunges and pulls prey toward the bank.
reed-lurker.advice: Cross on firm high ground instead of entering the shallows.
reed-lurker.materialsNote: Silver ivy grows along the bank that the creature had made unsafe to reach. A separate rare component is used for advanced equipment or permanent castle improvements.

hearth-ash-hound.name: Hearth-ash hound
hearth-ash-hound.appearance: A lean elemental hound of charcoal and cracked fired clay, with embers in the fissures.
hearth-ash-hound.signs: Warm paw-shaped ash marks near old kilns and unusually fast-burning fuel.
hearth-ash-hound.behaviour: Follows heat and fresh fuel. It circles an active fire before pouncing.
hearth-ash-hound.advice: Water and ice are effective; fire cannot damage it. Smother nearby fuel to draw it off.
hearth-ash-hound.materialsNote: Recover fireglass formed in the heat of the occupied kiln. A separate rare component is used for advanced equipment or permanent castle improvements.

root-mimic.name: Root mimic
root-mimic.appearance: A knot of mobile roots that resembles a fallen stump while resting.
root-mimic.signs: Freshly turned soil beneath a log that has no matching broken tree nearby.
root-mimic.behaviour: Reaches for movement nearby and restrains intruders with flexible roots.
root-mimic.advice: Find the main anchoring root and draw the smaller roots away from the path.
root-mimic.materialsNote: Recover living silver-ivy cuttings caught in the moving root mass. A separate rare component is used for advanced equipment or permanent castle improvements.

moss-troll.name: Moss troll
moss-troll.appearance: A broad, heavy person with stony skin, mossy shoulders and a blunt expressive face.
moss-troll.signs: Large bare footprints, stacked boundary stones and a cooking place near shelter.
moss-troll.behaviour: Can speak and negotiate. Some guard a bridge or demand that travellers respect a boundary.
moss-troll.advice: Ask what it is protecting and agree safe passage. Hostility belongs to the situation, not its species.
moss-troll.materialsNote: Gather silver ivy from the bridge bank after the crossing is settled. A separate rare component is used for advanced equipment or permanent castle improvements.

ruin-gargoyle.name: Ruin gargoyle
ruin-gargoyle.appearance: A carved stone guardian with chipped wings and animal features chosen by its sculptor.
ruin-gargoyle.signs: Repeated scrape marks around a gate and matching carved symbols on nearby posts.
ruin-gargoyle.behaviour: Repeats its maker’s boundary command; it does not hunt for food.
ruin-gargoyle.advice: Read the boundary marks and follow the permitted route. Lightning is effective against its construct body.
ruin-gargoyle.materialsNote: Recover loose clay and moon-glass fragments from the damaged ward post. A separate rare component is used for advanced equipment or permanent castle improvements.

restless-sentry.name: Restless sentry
restless-sentry.appearance: An animated skeleton in worn practical armour, still carrying an old watch weapon.
restless-sentry.signs: Regular boot scrapes, a repeating patrol route and fragments of an old watch roster.
restless-sentry.behaviour: Repeats a duty from the abandoned post and challenges movement across its route.
restless-sentry.advice: Use the old watch orders to secure passage. Magic that harms undead is effective.
restless-sentry.materialsNote: Recover an intact moon-glass setting from the abandoned watch equipment. A separate rare component is used for advanced equipment or permanent castle improvements.

wolf.name: Grey wolf
wolf.appearance: A grey woodland predator with a thick coat and a lean, four-legged build.
wolf.signs: Four-toed prints, narrow tracks and chewed remains beside covered resting places.
wolf.behaviour: Wolves test a group’s edges and look for isolated or weakened targets.
wolf.advice: Keep the group together and leave the wolves an escape route.
wolf.materialsNote: Gather silver ivy from the cleared path. A separate rare component is used for advanced equipment or permanent castle improvements.

griffin.name: Ridge griffin
griffin.appearance: A ridge predator with eagle forequarters, folded feathered wings and lion hindquarters.
griffin.signs: Large talon marks, tawny fur and fallen flight feathers around high nesting ledges.
griffin.behaviour: Defends a claimed perch and dives at anyone approaching the nest.
griffin.advice: Watch its circling route and pass below the nesting ledge.
griffin.materialsNote: Recover moon-glass cargo dropped on the now-accessible ridge path. A separate rare component is used for advanced equipment or permanent castle improvements.

bovinefolk.name: Bovinefolk
bovinefolk.appearance: Bovine horns, bovine ears and a slender tufted tail, a human face and smooth human skin without body fur.
bovinefolk.nature: People with horns, bovine ears and a tufted tail, a human face and smooth skin without body fur.
bovinefolk.accommodation: Allow clearance for horns and a tail opening in clothes; do not assume a particular occupation or temperament.
bovinefolk.mechanics: Ancestry alone adds no attribute, skill, combat bonus or immunity. The person’s approved abilities, learned skills, spells and equipment determine what they can do.
bovinefolk.exampleNote: One adult example of this ancestry. Individual appearance, clothing and personality vary.

orc.name: Orc
orc.appearance: Green skin, strong features, small tusks rooted in the lower jaw, and a sturdy build.
orc.nature: Green-skinned people with strong features and small lower tusks. Builds and personal tastes vary.
orc.accommodation: Fit mouthguards around tusks and clothing to the individual’s build.
orc.mechanics: Ancestry alone adds no attribute, skill, combat bonus or immunity. The person’s approved abilities, learned skills, spells and equipment determine what they can do.
orc.exampleNote: One adult example of this ancestry. Individual appearance, clothing and personality vary.

wolfkin.name: Wolfkin
wolfkin.appearance: Expressive wolf ears and a fluffy wolf tail, a human face and smooth human skin.
wolfkin.nature: Human-faced people with expressive wolf ears and a thick wolf tail. They are people, distinct from the wolves found on patrols.
wolfkin.accommodation: Provide room for the tail in clothing and seats; helmets must fit the ears.
wolfkin.mechanics: Ancestry alone adds no attribute, skill, combat bonus or immunity. The person’s approved abilities, learned skills, spells and equipment determine what they can do.
wolfkin.exampleNote: One adult example of this ancestry. Individual appearance, clothing and personality vary.

oni.name: Oni
oni.appearance: Two strong horns and a powerful imposing frame with mature generous curves and a large bust.
oni.nature: Horned people with sturdy, often generously curved builds. Skin colours include muted red, copper-brown and dusky blue.
oni.accommodation: Check horn clearance, sturdy seating and comfortable clothing; no special room surcharge is added.
oni.mechanics: Ancestry alone adds no attribute, skill, combat bonus or immunity. The person’s approved abilities, learned skills, spells and equipment determine what they can do.
oni.exampleNote: One adult example of this ancestry. Individual appearance, clothing and personality vary.

human.name: Human
human.nature: Human communities include travellers, craft workers and scholars. People vary widely in build, skin colour and family traditions.
human.accommodation: Ordinary rooms and clothes suit most people; ask about individual preferences.
human.mechanics: Ancestry alone adds no attribute, skill, combat bonus or immunity. The person’s approved abilities, learned skills, spells and equipment determine what they can do.
human.exampleNote: One adult example of this ancestry. Individual appearance, clothing and personality vary.

high-elf.name: High elf
high-elf.appearance: Long pointed ears and woodland-inspired personal adornments.
high-elf.nature: Fair-skinned elves whose long pointed ears and woodland adornments often reflect ties to forest settlements. Individual occupations and loyalties vary.
high-elf.accommodation: Leave room for long ears in helmets and hoods.
high-elf.mechanics: Ancestry alone adds no attribute, skill, combat bonus or immunity. The person’s approved abilities, learned skills, spells and equipment determine what they can do.
high-elf.exampleNote: One adult example of this ancestry. Individual appearance, clothing and personality vary.

dark-elf.name: Dark elf
dark-elf.appearance: Rich chocolate-brown skin, pointed ears and fine expressive features.
dark-elf.nature: Chocolate-brown-skinned elves with pointed ears. Their settlements and occupations are varied; they are distinct from subterranean drow.
dark-elf.accommodation: Fit helmets and hoods around their ears.
dark-elf.mechanics: Ancestry alone adds no attribute, skill, combat bonus or immunity. The person’s approved abilities, learned skills, spells and equipment determine what they can do.
dark-elf.exampleNote: One adult example of this ancestry. Individual appearance, clothing and personality vary.

drow.name: Drow
drow.appearance: Slate, charcoal or violet-grey skin, pointed ears and eyes adapted to dim surroundings.
drow.nature: Elves from subterranean communities, with slate, charcoal or violet-grey skin and eyes suited to dim surroundings.
drow.accommodation: Offer adjustable lamplight and sheltered sleeping space; room eligibility still follows the person’s stated needs.
drow.mechanics: Ancestry alone adds no attribute, skill, combat bonus or immunity. The person’s approved abilities, learned skills, spells and equipment determine what they can do.
drow.exampleNote: One adult example of this ancestry. Individual appearance, clothing and personality vary.

catfolk.name: Catfolk
catfolk.appearance: Expressive feline ears and a softly furred tail.
catfolk.nature: Human-faced people with feline ears and a softly furred tail. Their skin is otherwise humanlike.
catfolk.accommodation: Use seating, clothes and headwear that leave ears and tail comfortable.
catfolk.mechanics: Ancestry alone adds no attribute, skill, combat bonus or immunity. The person’s approved abilities, learned skills, spells and equipment determine what they can do.
catfolk.exampleNote: One adult example of this ancestry. Individual appearance, clothing and personality vary.

kitsune.name: Kitsune
kitsune.appearance: Fox ears and one luxuriant fox tail; tail count conveys no free magical power.
kitsune.nature: Fox-eared people with a luxuriant fox tail. Tail count does not grant an automatic magical rank.
kitsune.accommodation: Headwear and clothing need ear and tail clearance.
kitsune.mechanics: Ancestry alone adds no attribute, skill, combat bonus or immunity. The person’s approved abilities, learned skills, spells and equipment determine what they can do.
kitsune.exampleNote: One adult example of this ancestry. Individual appearance, clothing and personality vary.

golem.name: Golem
golem.appearance: A carefully crafted adult feminine form with fine visible maker’s joins.
golem.nature: Sentient people awakened in deliberately crafted adult bodies. Clay, porcelain, stone, wood and metal are supported construction materials. Their maker is not their owner.
golem.accommodation: Use the chosen body material and the individual’s accommodation request when preparing a room.
golem.mechanics: Ancestry alone adds no attribute, skill, combat bonus or immunity. The person’s approved abilities, learned skills, spells and equipment determine what they can do.
golem.exampleNote: One adult example of this ancestry. Individual appearance, clothing and personality vary.

demon.name: Demon
demon.appearance: Small swept horns and a slender expressive tail.
demon.nature: Otherworldly people whose traits may include horns, tails and leathery wings. Appearance does not determine morality, consent or profession.
demon.accommodation: Allow room for horns, tails and wings; follow the individual’s stated accommodation needs.
demon.mechanics: Ancestry alone adds no attribute, skill, combat bonus or immunity. The person’s approved abilities, learned skills, spells and equipment determine what they can do.
demon.exampleNote: One adult example of this ancestry. Individual appearance, clothing and personality vary.

seraph.name: Seraph
seraph.appearance: Soft feathered wings with subtly luminous edges.
seraph.nature: Otherworldly people with feathered wings. Skin colours and occupations vary; wings do not establish authority over anyone else.
seraph.accommodation: Leave enough space to fold and care for wings. Flight routes still require a listed ability or spell.
seraph.mechanics: Ancestry alone adds no attribute, skill, combat bonus or immunity. The person’s approved abilities, learned skills, spells and equipment determine what they can do.
seraph.exampleNote: One adult example of this ancestry. Individual appearance, clothing and personality vary.

elemental.name: Elemental
elemental.appearance: Mineral-flecked skin and a faint inner shimmer.
elemental.nature: People whose bodies express an element, including water, fire, air or mineral earth. The illustration shows one water elemental, not every possible form.
elemental.accommodation: Choose surroundings with the person’s stated elemental needs in mind. Their approved ability package determines practical magic.
elemental.mechanics: Ancestry alone adds no attribute, skill, combat bonus or immunity. The person’s approved abilities, learned skills, spells and equipment determine what they can do.
elemental.exampleNote: One adult example of this ancestry. Individual appearance, clothing and personality vary.

vampire.name: Vampire
vampire.appearance: Delicate fangs and attentive luminous eyes.
vampire.nature: People with small fangs and distinctive attentive eyes. Feeding needs and personal boundaries must be discussed with the individual.
vampire.accommodation: Follow the individual’s care and room requirements. This reference adds no hidden feeding timer or automatic damage.
vampire.mechanics: Ancestry alone adds no attribute, skill, combat bonus or immunity. The person’s approved abilities, learned skills, spells and equipment determine what they can do.
vampire.exampleNote: One adult example of this ancestry. Individual appearance, clothing and personality vary.

fae.name: Fae
fae.appearance: Leaflike ears and small iridescent markings.
fae.nature: Otherworldly people with leaflike ears or iridescent markings. Fae traditions differ between communities and individuals.
fae.accommodation: Ask about preferred surroundings and personal boundaries; no universal bargain or compulsion is assumed.
fae.mechanics: Ancestry alone adds no attribute, skill, combat bonus or immunity. The person’s approved abilities, learned skills, spells and equipment determine what they can do.
fae.exampleNote: One adult example of this ancestry. Individual appearance, clothing and personality vary.

djinn.name: Djinn
djinn.appearance: A gentle smoke-like shimmer around her hair.
djinn.nature: Otherworldly people whose hair or silhouette may carry a faint smoke-like shimmer. They have their own lives and reasons to visit.
djinn.accommodation: Agree accommodation and work directly. Summoning does not create ownership or compulsory service.
djinn.mechanics: Ancestry alone adds no attribute, skill, combat bonus or immunity. The person’s approved abilities, learned skills, spells and equipment determine what they can do.
djinn.exampleNote: One adult example of this ancestry. Individual appearance, clothing and personality vary.

dragonkin.name: Dragonkin
dragonkin.appearance: Small curved horns and fine scales at her temples.
dragonkin.nature: People with curved horns and fine scales, sometimes with a scaled tail. Features vary without determining their learned discipline.
dragonkin.accommodation: Fit clothes around horns, scales and any tail; discuss heat preferences individually.
dragonkin.mechanics: Ancestry alone adds no attribute, skill, combat bonus or immunity. The person’s approved abilities, learned skills, spells and equipment determine what they can do.
dragonkin.exampleNote: One adult example of this ancestry. Individual appearance, clothing and personality vary.

dryad.name: Dryad
dryad.appearance: Living bark skin, leaf-shaped ears and growing vines or twigs; personal forms and colours vary.
dryad.nature: Plant-bodied people with living bark, leaflike ears and growing vines or twigs. They are living people, not humans wearing leaves.
dryad.accommodation: Offer suitable light and space for living growth, guided by the individual’s room request.
dryad.mechanics: Ancestry alone adds no attribute, skill, combat bonus or immunity. The person’s approved abilities, learned skills, spells and equipment determine what they can do.
dryad.exampleNote: One adult example of this ancestry. Individual appearance, clothing and personality vary.

nymph.name: Nymph
nymph.appearance: Dew-bright markings and a soft natural shimmer.
nymph.nature: People with a close affinity for springs, groves or other natural places, sometimes marked by a dew-like sheen.
nymph.accommodation: Discuss the surroundings they prefer; a natural affinity does not replace individual needs.
nymph.mechanics: Ancestry alone adds no attribute, skill, combat bonus or immunity. The person’s approved abilities, learned skills, spells and equipment determine what they can do.
nymph.exampleNote: One adult example of this ancestry. Individual appearance, clothing and personality vary.

spirit.name: Spirit
spirit.appearance: A pearly translucent glow at the edges of her silhouette.
spirit.nature: People whose bodies can have softly translucent edges. Each has a distinct identity, interests and boundaries.
spirit.accommodation: Ask which physical surroundings are comfortable. Translucence grants no unlisted passage through walls or immunity.
spirit.mechanics: Ancestry alone adds no attribute, skill, combat bonus or immunity. The person’s approved abilities, learned skills, spells and equipment determine what they can do.
spirit.exampleNote: One adult example of this ancestry. Individual appearance, clothing and personality vary.

wolf.name: Hungry wolves
wolf.text: Wolves block the track near an abandoned food sack. Keep an escape route open.
wolf.materialsNote: Gather silver ivy from the cleared path.

boar.name: Briarback boar
boar.text: A boar charges from the undergrowth. Drive it off before recovering the scattered supplies.
boar.materialsNote: Recover usable binding thread from the overturned supply cart.

thief.name: Roadside thieves
thief.text: Thieves have cut a wagon harness and are carrying away its cargo. The merchants offer a recovery fee.

bandit.name: Armed bandits
bandit.text: Bandits demand a toll at a narrow crossing. Their leader watches for anyone breaking formation.

griffin.name: Ridge griffin
griffin.text: A griffin has claimed the ridge above a mineral outcrop. Secure passage; there is no need to kill it.
griffin.materialsNote: Recover moon-glass cargo dropped on the now-accessible ridge path.

ember-hound.name: Hearth-ash hound
ember-hound.text: A hound with a coal-bright mane stalks the old boundary. Water and ice are more effective than fire.
ember-hound.materialsNote: Recover fireglass formed in the heat of the occupied kiln.

slatehide-lizard.name: Slatehide lizard
slatehide-lizard.text: The creature blocks a quarry ledge beside scattered supplies. Secure a safe route for the work party.

approach.name: Lure it away from the quarry ledge

slatehide-lizard.materialsNote: Mineral-rich clay is scraped from the lizard’s abandoned ledge.

storm-antler-stag.text: The creature controls a ridge crossing used by travellers. Secure passage through its territory.
storm-antler-stag.materialsNote: Recover a moon-glass fragment exposed where the stag’s charge struck the old boundary stones.

approach.name: Lead it away with a shaded lantern

approach.name: Trace a safe route around its web

grave-silk-spider.materialsNote: Ordinary abandoned silk is cleaned and spun into binding thread; the rare intact strands are kept separately.

reed-lurker.name: Reed lurker

approach.name: Find a dry route above the bank

reed-lurker.materialsNote: Silver ivy grows along the bank that the creature had made unsafe to reach.

approach.name: Divert its roots from the path

root-mimic.materialsNote: Recover living silver-ivy cuttings caught in the moving root mass.

moss-troll.name: Moss troll
moss-troll.text: The creature controls a ridge crossing used by travellers. Secure passage through its territory.
moss-troll.materialsNote: Gather silver ivy from the bridge bank after the crossing is settled.

ruin-gargoyle.name: Ruin gargoyle
ruin-gargoyle.text: The creature guards a ruined outbuilding beside recoverable supplies. Secure safe access.

approach.name: Read and follow the boundary command
